fusions.name: Fine-Line Cut
fusions.desc: A slicing page edge that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sewn Into the Spine
fusions.desc: Lashes binding thread around you that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Strand-Laid Sheets
fusions.desc: Laces your pages with strands that raise your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Calligrapher's Brush
fusions.desc: Conjures a calligrapher's brush with an edge. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
